# Exercise 13: Jinja2 Templates

## Learning Objectives

- Create Jinja2 template files
- Use variables in templates
- Implement template logic (loops, conditions)
- Apply filters and tests

## Prerequisites

- Completed Exercise 12
- Understanding of variables

## Steps

### Step 1: Create a Basic Template

Create a simple Jinja2 template:

```bash
mkdir -p /tmp/templates

cat > /tmp/templates/basic.conf.j2 << 'EOF'
# Basic Configuration File
# Generated by Ansible

[application]
name={{ app_name }}
version={{ app_version }}
port={{ app_port }}
debug={{ debug_mode | lower }}

[server]
hostname={{ ansible_hostname }}
ip_address={{ ansible_default_ipv4.address | default('N/A') }}
EOF

# Create playbook to use the template
cat > basic-template.yml << 'EOF'
---
- name: Basic Template Usage
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    app_name: MyApp
    app_version: 1.0.0
    app_port: 8080
    debug_mode: true
  
  tasks:
    - name: Deploy configuration from template
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/basic.conf.j2
        dest: /tmp/basic-config.conf
        mode: '0644'
    
    - name: Display generated configuration
      command: cat /tmp/basic-config.conf
      register: config_content
      changed_when: false
    
    - name: Show config content
      debug:
        var: config_content.stdout_lines
EOF
```

### Step 2: Run Basic Template

```bash
ansible-playbook basic-template.yml
cat /tmp/basic-config.conf
```

### Step 3: Template with Loops

Create a template using loops:

```bash
cat > /tmp/templates/users.conf.j2 << 'EOF'
# User Configuration
# Generated: {{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }}

[users]
{% for user in users %}
username={{ user.name }}
uid={{ user.uid }}
shell={{ user.shell }}
groups={{ user.groups | join(',') }}

{% endfor %}

[summary]
total_users={{ users | length }}
EOF

cat > template-loops.yml << 'EOF'
---
- name: Template with Loops
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  vars:
    users:
      - name: alice
        uid: 1001
        shell: /bin/bash
        groups: [admin, developers]
      - name: bob
        uid: 1002
        shell: /bin/zsh
        groups: [developers]
      - name: charlie
        uid: 1003
        shell: /bin/bash
        groups: [users, testers]
  
  tasks:
    - name: Generate user configuration
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/users.conf.j2
        dest: /tmp/users-config.conf
    
    - name: Display generated configuration
      command: cat /tmp/users-config.conf
      register: output
      changed_when: false
    
    - name: Show output
      debug:
        var: output.stdout_lines
EOF
```

### Step 4: Test Loop Template

```bash
ansible-playbook template-loops.yml
cat /tmp/users-config.conf
```

### Step 5: Template with Conditionals

Create a template with conditional logic:

```bash
cat > /tmp/templates/app.conf.j2 << 'EOF'
# Application Configuration
# Environment: {{ environment }}

[application]
name={{ app_name }}
version={{ app_version }}

{% if environment == 'production' %}
# Production Settings
debug=false
log_level=ERROR
max_connections=1000
{% elif environment == 'staging' %}
# Staging Settings
debug=true
log_level=INFO
max_connections=100
{% else %}
# Development Settings
debug=true
log_level=DEBUG
max_connections=10
{% endif %}

[database]
host={{ db_host }}
port={{ db_port }}
{% if db_ssl_enabled is defined and db_ssl_enabled %}
ssl_enabled=true
ssl_cert={{ db_ssl_cert }}
{% else %}
ssl_enabled=false
{% endif %}

[features]
{% if features is defined %}
{% for feature, enabled in features.items() %}
{{ feature }}={{ enabled | lower }}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}

{% if backup_enabled | default(false) %}
[backup]
enabled=true
schedule={{ backup_schedule | default('0 2 * * *') }}
retention_days={{ backup_retention | default(7) }}
{% endif %}
EOF

cat > template-conditionals.yml << 'EOF'
---
- name: Template with Conditionals
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  vars:
    app_name: MyApplication
    app_version: 2.0.0
    environment: production
    db_host: db.example.com
    db_port: 5432
    db_ssl_enabled: true
    db_ssl_cert: /path/to/cert.pem
    backup_enabled: true
    backup_schedule: "0 3 * * *"
    backup_retention: 14
    features:
      caching: true
      monitoring: true
      analytics: false
  
  tasks:
    - name: Generate production configuration
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/app.conf.j2
        dest: /tmp/app-prod.conf
    
    - name: Generate development configuration
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/app.conf.j2
        dest: /tmp/app-dev.conf
      vars:
        environment: development
        db_ssl_enabled: false
        backup_enabled: false
    
    - name: Show production config
      command: cat /tmp/app-prod.conf
      register: prod_config
      changed_when: false
    
    - name: Display production config
      debug:
        var: prod_config.stdout_lines
EOF
```

### Step 6: Test Conditional Template

```bash
ansible-playbook template-conditionals.yml

# Compare the configs
cat /tmp/app-prod.conf
echo "---"
cat /tmp/app-dev.conf
```

### Step 7: Template Filters

Create a template demonstrating various filters:

```bash
cat > /tmp/templates/filters.j2 << 'EOF'
# Template Filters Example
# Generated: {{ ansible_date_time.date }}

[string_filters]
uppercase={{ app_name | upper }}
lowercase={{ app_name | lower }}
title={{ app_name | title }}
length={{ app_name | length }}
default={{ undefined_var | default('default_value') }}

[list_filters]
{% set my_list = ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry', 'date'] %}
first={{ my_list | first }}
last={{ my_list | last }}
length={{ my_list | length }}
join={{ my_list | join(', ') }}
sorted={{ my_list | sort | join(', ') }}
reverse={{ my_list | reverse | list | join(', ') }}

[dict_filters]
{% set my_dict = {'key1': 'value1', 'key2': 'value2'} %}
keys={{ my_dict.keys() | list | join(', ') }}
values={{ my_dict.values() | list | join(', ') }}
json={{ my_dict | to_json }}
yaml={{ my_dict | to_yaml }}

[number_filters]
{% set my_number = 42 %}
original={{ my_number }}
float={{ my_number | float }}
abs={{ -15 | abs }}
{% set numbers = [5, 2, 8, 1, 9] %}
min={{ numbers | min }}
max={{ numbers | max }}
sum={{ numbers | sum }}

[path_filters]
basename={{ '/path/to/file.txt' | basename }}
dirname={{ '/path/to/file.txt' | dirname }}

[conditional_filters]
{% set port = 80 %}
is_defined={{ port is defined }}
is_number={{ port is number }}
is_string={{ app_name is string }}
EOF

cat > template-filters.yml << 'EOF'
---
- name: Template Filters
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  vars:
    app_name: MyApplication
  
  tasks:
    - name: Generate filter examples
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/filters.j2
        dest: /tmp/filters-output.txt
    
    - name: Display output
      command: cat /tmp/filters-output.txt
      register: output
      changed_when: false
    
    - name: Show output
      debug:
        var: output.stdout_lines
EOF
```

### Step 8: Test Filters

```bash
ansible-playbook template-filters.yml
cat /tmp/filters-output.txt
```

### Step 9: Complex Template Example

Create a realistic web server configuration:

```bash
cat > /tmp/templates/nginx.conf.j2 << 'EOF'
# Nginx Configuration
# Generated by Ansible on {{ ansible_date_time.iso8601 }}
# Host: {{ ansible_hostname }}

user {{ nginx_user }};
worker_processes {{ nginx_worker_processes | default(ansible_processor_cores) }};
pid {{ nginx_pid_file }};

events {
    worker_connections {{ nginx_worker_connections }};
    {% if nginx_use_epoll %}
    use epoll;
    {% endif %}
}

http {
    # Basic Settings
    sendfile on;
    tcp_nopush on;
    tcp_nodelay on;
    keepalive_timeout {{ nginx_keepalive_timeout }};
    types_hash_max_size 2048;

    # MIME Types
    include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
    default_type application/octet-stream;

    # Logging
    access_log {{ nginx_access_log }};
    error_log {{ nginx_error_log }} {{ nginx_error_log_level }};

    # Gzip Settings
    {% if nginx_gzip_enabled %}
    gzip on;
    gzip_disable "msie6";
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_types {{ nginx_gzip_types | join(' ') }};
    {% endif %}

    # Virtual Hosts
    {% for vhost in virtual_hosts %}
    server {
        listen {{ vhost.port }}{% if vhost.default | default(false) %} default_server{% endif %};
        server_name {{ vhost.server_name }};
        root {{ vhost.root }};
        index {{ vhost.index | default('index.html index.htm') }};

        {% if vhost.ssl | default(false) %}
        # SSL Configuration
        listen {{ vhost.ssl_port }} ssl;
        ssl_certificate {{ vhost.ssl_cert }};
        ssl_certificate_key {{ vhost.ssl_key }};
        {% endif %}

        location / {
            try_files $uri $uri/ =404;
        }

        {% if vhost.locations is defined %}
        {% for location in vhost.locations %}
        location {{ location.path }} {
            {% if location.proxy_pass is defined %}
            proxy_pass {{ location.proxy_pass }};
            proxy_set_header Host $host;
            proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
            {% endif %}
        }
        {% endfor %}
        {% endif %}
    }
    {% endfor %}
}
EOF

cat > complex-template.yml << 'EOF'
---
- name: Complex Nginx Configuration
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: yes
  vars:
    nginx_user: www-data
    nginx_worker_processes: auto
    nginx_pid_file: /var/run/nginx.pid
    nginx_worker_connections: 1024
    nginx_use_epoll: true
    nginx_keepalive_timeout: 65
    nginx_access_log: /var/log/nginx/access.log
    nginx_error_log: /var/log/nginx/error.log
    nginx_error_log_level: warn
    nginx_gzip_enabled: true
    nginx_gzip_types:
      - text/plain
      - text/css
      - application/json
      - application/javascript
    
    virtual_hosts:
      - server_name: example.com
        port: 80
        root: /var/www/example
        default: true
        ssl: true
        ssl_port: 443
        ssl_cert: /etc/nginx/ssl/example.crt
        ssl_key: /etc/nginx/ssl/example.key
        locations:
          - path: /api
            proxy_pass: http://localhost:8080
      
      - server_name: test.example.com
        port: 80
        root: /var/www/test
        locations:
          - path: /app
            proxy_pass: http://localhost:3000
  
  tasks:
    - name: Generate nginx configuration
      template:
        src: /tmp/templates/nginx.conf.j2
        dest: /tmp/nginx.conf
        validate: 'test -f %s'
    
    - name: Display configuration
      command: cat /tmp/nginx.conf
      register: nginx_conf
      changed_when: false
    
    - name: Show nginx configuration
      debug:
        var: nginx_conf.stdout_lines
EOF
```

### Step 10: Test Complex Template

```bash
ansible-playbook complex-template.yml
cat /tmp/nginx.conf
```

## Common Jinja2 Syntax

### Variables
```jinja2
{{ variable_name }}
{{ dict.key }}
{{ list[0] }}
```

### Conditions
```jinja2
{% if condition %}
content
{% elif other_condition %}
other content
{% else %}
default content
{% endif %}
```

### Loops
```jinja2
{% for item in list %}
{{ item }}
{% endfor %}
```

### Filters
```jinja2
{{ variable | filter_name }}
{{ variable | filter(param) }}
```

### Comments
```jinja2
{# This is a comment #}
```

## Useful Filters

| Filter | Example | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| `default` | `{{ var \| default('N/A') }}` | Default value |
| `upper/lower` | `{{ text \| upper }}` | Change case |
| `join` | `{{ list \| join(',') }}` | Join list items |
| `length` | `{{ list \| length }}` | Get length |
| `to_json` | `{{ dict \| to_json }}` | Convert to JSON |
| `to_yaml` | `{{ dict \| to_yaml }}` | Convert to YAML |
| `basename` | `{{ path \| basename }}` | Get filename |
| `dirname` | `{{ path \| dirname }}` | Get directory |

## Troubleshooting

### Problem: Template syntax error

**Solution:** Check Jinja2 syntax, quotes, and brackets
```bash
ansible-playbook playbook.yml --syntax-check
```

### Problem: Variable undefined in template

**Solution:** Use default filter or check variable definition
```jinja2
{{ variable | default('default_value') }}
```

### Problem: Whitespace issues

**Solution:** Use `-` to strip whitespace
```jinja2
{%- if condition -%}
content
{%- endif -%}
```
